content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

This method of selling Notion templates involves creating a streamlined process for digital product delivery without relying on conventional payment systems. The infrastructure allows creators to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, bypassing the fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on each sale. By using a solution like NOWPayments, which only charges 0.5%, you can keep more of your earnings. This is crucial in regions where financial systems are unstable or non-functional, as it empowers creators to build sustainable businesses.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is built on several free tools that work together seamlessly. Hosting can be done on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring your templates are always accessible. For backend logic, you can use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment processing and order fulfillment. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain, allowing for instant product delivery. This end-to-end solution ensures you maintain full ownership of your data and sales process, a critical factor for creators in restrictive environments.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries facing payment processor restrictions. Artists, educators, and entrepreneurs selling ebooks, courses, and templates can benefit from a system that allows them to operate independently. By leveraging cryptocurrency, these creators can engage with a global market without the barriers traditionally imposed by payment platforms. This approach is not just about selling products; it's about establishing a sovereign digital presence that is resilient against local economic challenges.
Retain more profits by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this infrastructure include hosting services like GitHub Pages for product display, NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, and Google Drive for file delivery. Each element plays a crucial role in the overall functionality. By integrating these tools, you create a robust digital storefront where customers can purchase and receive your Notion templates automatically. The combination of these technologies not only ensures a smooth user experience but also significantly reduces operational costs, reinforcing your profitability.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by selecting the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack to set up your infrastructure quickly. Deploy your store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and configure your backend with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. Load your Notion templates into your chosen storage solution, such as Google Drive, ensuring instant delivery to customers. Finally, promote your store and leverage social media to reach your audience. This streamlined process empowers you to start selling today.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Own your data and sales process completely.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept various digital currencies directly, avoiding the restrictions and fees associated with traditional platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to establish your own online store using free tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, combined with NOWPayments for crypto transactions.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by leveraging decentralized payment options like cryptocurrencies and creating your own storefront using the infrastructure provided by COREMERCH.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This extensive range allows you to cater to a wide audience of crypto users.
How do I ensure my digital products are delivered automatically?

To ensure automatic delivery of your digital products, utilize Google Drive for file storage and set up backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery process upon payment confirmation.
